summary.en: Regulates substances entering and leaving the cell.
summary.zh: 调节物质进出细胞。

detail.en:
The cell membrane separates the inside of this animal cell from its surroundings. It regulates the passage of substances; it is not a rigid cell wall [S4].

The smooth irregular boundary surrounds a slightly flattened epithelial example. The illustration has an exposed front face and an exaggerated rolled membrane edge, so its contents are readable in the assembled view; a real membrane is far thinner [S20].
detail.zh:
细胞膜分隔这个动物细胞的内外，调节物质进出；它不是坚硬的细胞壁 [S4]。

平滑而不规则的边界围住一个略扁的上皮细胞。图示敞开正面，并把膜的边缘加厚，让完整视图中的内部结构也能辨认；真实细胞膜远薄于此 [S20]。

summary.en: Supports many chemical reactions in the cell.
summary.zh: 是细胞内许多化学反应发生的区域。

detail.en:
Cytoplasm occupies the region inside the membrane and outside the nucleus. Many chemical reactions occur here; the model leaves a space for the nucleus rather than filling it with another solid layer [S4].

The opaque warm surface is an exposed illustration of cytoplasm, with mitochondria and their folded inner membranes, curved membrane sacs and small granules. These details belong to the same cytoplasm selection; colours and sizes are explanatory choices, not an unstained microscope view [S4, S20].
detail.zh:
细胞质位于细胞膜以内、细胞核以外，许多化学反应在这里发生。模型为细胞核留出空间，没有用第二层实心材料把核填满 [S4]。

暖色不透明表面表示敞开的细胞质图示，其中有线粒体及其折叠内膜、弯曲膜囊和小颗粒。这些细节随细胞质一起选中；颜色和尺寸用于说明，不代表未经染色的显微视野 [S4, S20]。

summary.en: Holds genetic instructions and helps control the cell.
summary.zh: 保存遗传指令，并参与控制细胞活动。

detail.en:
The nucleus contains genetic material and helps control the activities of this example cell. It is a separate structure within the cytoplasm [S4].

This flattened epithelial example contains one nucleus with a visible nucleolus and scattered chromatin detail. Its position and explanatory colour do not imply that all animal cells have identical shapes or centrally placed nuclei; small vesicles remain omitted [S4, S20].
detail.zh:
细胞核含有遗传物质，参与控制这个示例细胞的活动；它是细胞质中的独立结构 [S4]。

这个扁平上皮细胞有一个核，图中可见核仁和分散的染色质细节。核的位置与说明用色不表示所有动物细胞形状相同或核总在中央；小囊泡仍省略 [S4, S20]。

summary.en: Supports and protects the plant cell.
summary.zh: 支持并保护植物细胞。

detail.en:
The cell wall lies outside the cell membrane. It supports and protects the plant cell, while the membrane still regulates passage into and out of the cell [S4].

The rounded rectangular shell is a design study of one photosynthetic plant cell. Wall thickness is exaggerated so the wall and membrane remain distinguishable; neither is a solid box filling the cell [S20].
detail.zh:
细胞壁在细胞膜外侧，支持和保护植物细胞。细胞膜仍然存在，继续调节物质进出 [S4]。

圆角长方壳代表一个能进行光合作用的植物细胞。模型把壁厚画大，让壁和膜可以分别辨认；两者都不是填满内部的实心盒子 [S20]。

summary.en: Regulates substances entering and leaving the cell.
summary.zh: 调节物质进出植物细胞。

detail.en:
The plant cell membrane forms a boundary just inside the cell wall and regulates substances passing into and out of the cell. The wall does not replace it [S4].

A narrow visual gap separates the two hollow shells in this model. That separation and the membrane thickness are enlarged for legibility, rather than measured from a microscope image [S20].
detail.zh:
植物细胞膜紧靠细胞壁内侧，形成细胞内外的边界并调节物质进出；细胞壁不会代替细胞膜 [S4]。

模型在两个中空薄壳之间留了可见间隙。间隙与膜厚都是为了辨认而放大，不是从显微图像量得的尺寸 [S20]。

summary.en: Supports reactions in the region around the vacuole.
summary.zh: 在大液泡外围，是许多化学反应发生的区域。

detail.en:
Much of the cytoplasm in a mature plant cell can lie around a large central vacuole. Many chemical reactions take place in the cytoplasm [S4].

A thickened peripheral layer with organelle relief surrounds a real central opening for the large vacuole. There is also a separate opening around the side nucleus. Mitochondria remain distinct from the six green chloroplasts; colours and thickness are illustrative [S4, S20].
detail.zh:
成熟植物细胞的大液泡外围可分布着一层细胞质；许多化学反应在细胞质中进行 [S4]。

加厚的周边细胞质与细胞器围住大液泡的中央空位，侧面另为细胞核留孔。线粒体与六个绿色叶绿体不同；颜色及厚度均作了说明性处理 [S4, S20]。

summary.en: Holds genetic instructions and helps control the cell.
summary.zh: 保存遗传指令，并参与控制细胞活动。

detail.en:
The nucleus contains genetic material and helps control cell activities. A large vacuole may leave it near the side of a mature plant cell, so position alone is not an identification rule [S4, S10].

This model places one nucleus outside the central vacuole with a visible gap. The location, size and separation are design choices for reading the model [S20].
detail.zh:
细胞核含有遗传物质，参与控制细胞活动。成熟植物细胞中的大液泡可使核靠近一侧，因此不能只凭位置辨认核 [S4, S10]。

模型只画一个核，位于中央液泡之外，两者有可见间隙。位置、大小和间隙是为了讲解而选择的设计值 [S20]。

summary.en: Use light energy to make food by photosynthesis.
summary.zh: 利用光能进行光合作用，制造食物。

detail.en:
Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, a pigment involved in absorbing light for photosynthesis. They occur in photosynthetic plant cells; not every plant cell has them [S4].

Six varied lens-shaped chloroplasts sit around the large vacuole. Each shows a few internal membrane stacks as an illustrative relief. Six is a design count, not a biological rule. Onion bulb epidermis normally lacks chloroplasts [S4, S20, S23, S24].
detail.zh:
叶绿体含有叶绿素；这种色素参与吸收光，供光合作用制造食物。叶绿体存在于进行光合作用的植物细胞中，并不是每个植物细胞都有 [S4]。

六个大小及方向略有差异的透镜形叶绿体围绕大液泡，每个都以浮雕方式示意少量内部膜堆。六个是设计数量，不是生物规律。洋葱鳞茎表皮通常没有叶绿体 [S4, S20, S23, S24]。

summary.en: Contains cell sap and helps support the plant cell.
summary.zh: 容纳细胞液，并帮助支持植物细胞。

detail.en:
A large central vacuole contains water and dissolved substances, often called cell sap. Its contents help maintain pressure against the cell wall and support a mature plant cell [S4].

The blue-green central pillow represents cell sap, not air or an empty hole. Its softly rounded design envelope remains 0.12 × 0.06 × 0.04 m in the enlarged model. Animal cells can have smaller vesicles, which are omitted here [S20, S4].
detail.zh:
大液泡中含有水和溶解物质，常称为细胞液。液泡内的液体有助于维持向细胞壁施加的压力，支持成熟植物细胞 [S4]。

蓝绿色的柔软中央体表示细胞液，不是空气或空洞。它的圆润设计包络在放大模型中仍为 0.12 × 0.06 × 0.04 米。动物细胞可有较小囊泡，此处省略 [S20, S4]。

summary.en: Supports the microscope on the bench.
summary.zh: 在台面上稳固支撑显微镜。

detail.en:
The broad base supports the microscope and houses the lower illumination assembly [S7].

This unbranded design is 0.18 m wide, 0.03 m tall and 0.14 m deep. In class, carry an instrument according to the teacher’s guidance; the general laboratory method supports the base while holding the arm [S20, S6].
detail.zh:
宽底座支撑显微镜，下方照明机构也位于这里 [S7]。

这个无品牌模型的底座设计为宽 0.18 米、高 0.03 米、深 0.14 米。课堂搬运应听从教师指导；一般实验室方法是握住镜臂，同时托住底座 [S20, S6]。

summary.en: Supports the head above the specimen.
summary.zh: 在标本上方支撑镜头机构。

detail.en:
The arm connects the base with the upper optical assembly. Its open shape leaves working space around the slide and stage [S7].

The model uses a curved cast support without reproducing a manufacturer’s design. It provides the arm grip identified in general laboratory carrying guidance; actual carrying instructions remain specific to the instrument and teacher [S20, S6, S21].
detail.zh:
镜臂连接底座和上方镜头机构；开放的轮廓给载物台和玻片留出操作空间 [S7]。

模型使用弧形支撑，不复制某个厂商的产品。一般实验室搬运指导会要求握住镜臂；具体搬法仍应遵照仪器说明和教师要求 [S20, S6, S21]。

summary.en: Magnifies the image formed by the objective.
summary.zh: 再次放大物镜形成的图像。

detail.en:
The eyepiece magnifies the image made by the objective. In a compound light microscope both lens systems contribute to total magnification [S3, S7].

This design has one eyepiece rated 10×. Its slight viewing tilt is a mechanical design choice; it is not a separate third objective. The visible end glass is part of the same eyepiece [S20].
detail.zh:
目镜进一步放大物镜形成的图像；复式光学显微镜的总放大率由这两组镜头共同决定 [S3, S7]。

本模型有一个设计倍率为 10 倍的目镜，略向观察者倾斜。末端玻璃仍属于同一目镜，并不是第四个物镜 [S20]。

summary.en: Keeps the optical elements aligned.
summary.zh: 使光学镜组保持对齐。

detail.en:
The body tube and head hold the upper optical system in alignment with the objective assembly [S7].

The enlarged model shows the external tube, rather than a ray tracing of every internal lens. The lower vertical optical axis passes through the active objective, coverslip, slide opening, condenser and light source [S20].
detail.zh:
镜筒和镜头座使上方光学系统与物镜机构保持对齐 [S7]。

模型展示镜筒外形，没有把内部每一片透镜都画成光线追迹。下方竖直光轴经过在位物镜、盖玻片、载物台光孔、聚光镜与光源 [S20]。

summary.en: Turns to put one objective on the optical axis.
summary.zh: 转动，使一个物镜对准光轴。

detail.en:
The nosepiece holds the objectives and brings one of them into the optical path. Change lenses using the nosepiece rather than pushing on a lens barrel [S6, S7].

The model has three indexed positions. Each complete pose places exactly one objective above the slide opening; the other two remain to the side. Only the indexed endpoints are optical observations [S20].
detail.zh:
物镜转换器承载物镜，并使其中一个进入光路。换镜时应转动物镜转换器，不要推压物镜镜筒 [S6, S7]。

模型有三个定位姿态，每个姿态都只有一个物镜对准玻片光孔，其余两个位于旁侧。只有定位完成的状态用于观察 [S20]。

summary.en: Forms a magnified image of the specimen.
summary.zh: 形成标本的放大图像。

detail.en:
The objective is the lens system close to the specimen and forms its magnified image. Start with the lowest-power objective to locate and centre a target [S3, S6].

This design objective is 4×. With the 10× eyepiece the simulated total is 40×. Its barrel is the shortest of the three model objectives; all indexed poses leave a positive gap above the coverslip [S20].
detail.zh:
物镜是靠近标本的镜组，形成标本的放大图像。先用最低倍物镜寻找目标并移到视野中央 [S3, S6]。

本物镜的设计倍率为 4 倍；配合 10 倍目镜，模拟总放大率为 40 倍。在三个模型物镜中，它的镜筒最短；每个定位姿态下，物镜与盖玻片之间都保留正间隙 [S20]。

summary.en: Forms a magnified image of the specimen.
summary.zh: 形成标本的放大图像。

detail.en:
The objective is the lens system close to the specimen and forms its magnified image. Start with the lowest-power objective to locate and centre a target [S3, S6].

This design objective is 10×. With the 10× eyepiece the simulated total is 100×. Its barrel is intermediate in length of the three model objectives; all indexed poses leave a positive gap above the coverslip [S20].
detail.zh:
物镜是靠近标本的镜组，形成标本的放大图像。先用最低倍物镜寻找目标并移到视野中央 [S3, S6]。

本物镜的设计倍率为 10 倍；配合 10 倍目镜，模拟总放大率为 100 倍。在三个模型物镜中，它的镜筒长度居中；每个定位姿态下，物镜与盖玻片之间都保留正间隙 [S20]。

summary.en: Forms a magnified image of the specimen.
summary.zh: 形成标本的放大图像。

detail.en:
The objective is the lens system close to the specimen and forms its magnified image. Start with the lowest-power objective to locate and centre a target [S3, S6].

This design objective is 40×. With the 10× eyepiece the simulated total is 400×. Its barrel is the longest of the three model objectives; all indexed poses leave a positive gap above the coverslip [S20].
detail.zh:
物镜是靠近标本的镜组，形成标本的放大图像。先用最低倍物镜寻找目标并移到视野中央 [S3, S6]。

本物镜的设计倍率为 40 倍；配合 10 倍目镜，模拟总放大率为 400 倍。在三个模型物镜中，它的镜筒最长；每个定位姿态下，物镜与盖玻片之间都保留正间隙 [S20]。

summary.en: Supports the slide above the light opening.
summary.zh: 在光孔上方托住载玻片。

detail.en:
The stage supports the slide. Its central opening allows light to pass from the condenser through the thin specimen and into the active objective [S7].

A shaped stage surrounds a clear 0.03 × 0.03 m aperture. Two spring clips hold the slide against the stage. The stage stays fixed in this activity; coarse stage travel is not offered as an interactive control [S20].
detail.zh:
载物台托住玻片。中央光孔让聚光镜送来的光通过薄标本，进入在位物镜 [S7]。

成形载物台围住 0.03 × 0.03 米的光孔；两只弹簧夹把玻片压在载物台上。本活动的载物台固定，不提供粗调载物台行程的控件 [S20]。

summary.en: Carries the thin specimen over the light opening.
summary.zh: 承载薄标本，使它位于光孔上方。

detail.en:
The glass slide supports a thin specimen for transmitted light observation. A thick or opaque specimen can obscure structures beneath it [S3, S6].

This teaching simulation uses prepared specimen patterns. The slide and coverslip move together by the same physical distance; cell model enlargement is not applied to their motion. Use prepared slides under the teacher’s guidance in class [S20, S6].
detail.zh:
载玻片承载用于透射光观察的薄标本。标本过厚或不透光时，下方结构可能被遮住 [S3, S6]。

本活动使用模拟预制玻片。载玻片与盖玻片按同一实际距离一起移动，不再乘上细胞模型的放大倍数。真实课堂请在教师指导下使用预制玻片 [S20, S6]。

summary.en: Covers the thin specimen on the slide.
summary.zh: 覆盖载玻片上的薄标本。

detail.en:
A coverslip is a thin glass cover over a prepared specimen. It is distinct from the larger supporting slide underneath [S6].

The model places it above the slide opening and moves it with the slide. The objective barrels remain above it in every indexed pose; the simulation does not teach specimen collection, cutting or staining [S20].
detail.zh:
盖玻片是覆盖薄标本的小玻璃片，与下方较大的载玻片是两个不同部件 [S6]。

模型把它放在光孔上方，随载玻片一起移动。每个物镜定位姿态都与盖玻片保持间隙；本活动不教授采样、切片或染色操作 [S20]。

summary.en: Concentrates light on the specimen.
summary.zh: 把照明光集中到标本处。

detail.en:
The condenser concentrates light onto the specimen from below the stage. It belongs to the illumination path, separate from the objective that forms the specimen image [S7].

Its barrel and upper glass share the slide opening’s vertical axis. This external model simplifies the internal condenser lens group [S20].
detail.zh:
聚光镜位于载物台下方，把照明光集中到标本处；它属于照明光路，与形成标本图像的物镜不同 [S7]。

模型的镜筒和顶部玻璃对准载物台光孔的竖直轴线，内部镜组作了简化 [S20]。

summary.en: Sends light upward through the specimen.
summary.zh: 从下方向上照亮标本。

detail.en:
The illuminator supplies light to the condenser and through the stage opening. Brightness affects visibility but does not change the lens magnification [S7].

The model light source is a pale glass disc in the base. Its brightness control changes the simulated field, rather than claiming a measured lamp output [S20].
detail.zh:
光源把光送向聚光镜，再穿过载物台光孔照亮标本。亮度影响观察效果，却不会改变镜头的放大率 [S7]。

底座中的浅色玻璃圆盘表示光源。亮度控件改变模拟视野，没有把结果声称为实测灯光输出 [S20]。

summary.en: Makes large focus changes on a real instrument.
summary.zh: 在真实仪器上作较大幅度的调焦。

detail.en:
A coarse focus control makes larger changes in the separation between the objective and specimen than fine focus. At high power, large movements can bring a lens into contact with the slide [S6].

This large knob is included for identification. It has no active control in the teaching simulation; only safe, limited fine focus is available [S20].
detail.zh:
粗调节器使物镜与标本之间的距离作较大幅度的变化。高倍观察时，大幅移动可能使镜头碰到玻片 [S6]。

模型保留大旋钮供辨认，不提供粗调驱动；试一试只开放范围有限的微调 [S20]。

summary.en: Makes small changes to bring details into focus.
summary.zh: 细调焦平面，使细节更清楚。

detail.en:
Fine focus makes small adjustments to the focal plane. It refines the image after the specimen has been located, especially at higher power [S6, S7].

The small knob is coaxial with the coarse knob. Its visible rotation is exaggerated for readability; the fixed stage does not make a large, unsafe movement towards an objective [S20].
detail.zh:
微调节器细调焦平面，在找到标本后进一步改善图像，尤其用于高倍观察 [S6, S7]。

小旋钮与粗调节器同轴。模型把可见转角作了说明性放大；固定的载物台不会向物镜作大幅危险移动 [S20]。

summary.en: Shows adjacent cells in one layer of plant tissue.
summary.zh: 展示植物组织中彼此相邻的一层细胞。

detail.en:
Onion bulb epidermis consists of joined plant cells. These non-photosynthetic bulb cells normally lack chloroplasts, providing a counterexample to the idea that every plant cell has chloroplasts [S23, S24].

Nine elongated cells form three staggered rows in this original relief. Irregular shared walls, pale cell contents and one nucleus per cell are illustration choices, not a recorded microscope image; the membrane is not separately resolved [S20].
detail.zh:
洋葱鳞茎表皮由相邻的植物细胞组成。这些不进行光合作用的鳞茎细胞通常没有叶绿体，可用来检验“所有植物细胞都有叶绿体”的说法 [S23, S24]。

原创浮雕中的九个长形细胞分成三行交错排列。不规则的相邻细胞壁、浅色内部和每个细胞的一个核都是绘图选择，不是真实显微照片；这里没有把细胞膜单独分辨出来 [S20]。

summary.en: Connects the enlarged cell to a plant organ.
summary.zh: 把放大的细胞连回植物器官。

detail.en:
A leaf is a plant organ built from tissues containing many cells. Photosynthetic leaf cells are one setting in which chloroplasts can be found [S1, S4].

The simplified outline links the enlarged cell model with the whole-plant topic. It is drawn at a separate explanatory scale and does not reproduce every leaf tissue [S20].
detail.zh:
叶是植物器官，由包含许多细胞的组织构成；进行光合作用的叶细胞是可以找到叶绿体的一种情形 [S1, S4]。

简化叶形把细胞模型连回整株植物主题。它采用独立的说明比例，没有重现叶的每一层组织 [S20]。

summary.en: Shows neighbouring cells working as a tissue.
summary.zh: 展示相邻细胞组成的组织。

detail.en:
A tissue is an organised group of cells working together. Tissues make up organs; an organ is not one giant cell [S3].

Six fitted cell profiles with visible nuclei form this original explanatory relief. Their outlines, colours and separate scale are design choices, not a microscopic observation or a claim that every tissue contains six cells [S20].
detail.zh:
组织是协同工作的细胞所组成的结构；组织构成器官，器官不是一个巨大的细胞 [S3]。

原创说明浮雕由六个相互贴合、带有可见细胞核的细胞轮廓组成。形状、颜色与独立尺度都是设计选择，不是显微观察，也不表示每种组织只有六个细胞 [S20]。

summary.en: Connects cells and tissues to a digestive organ.
summary.zh: 把细胞与组织连回消化器官。

detail.en:
The small intestine is an organ in the digestive system, made from tissues and cells. Digestion and absorption are explained in the digestive-system topic [S1, S3].

A short hollow curved tube is only an organ-level symbol. Its shape and size are schematic; it is not a medical anatomy model or one enormously enlarged cell [S20].
detail.zh:
小肠是消化系统中的器官，由组织和细胞构成。消化系统主题继续解释消化与吸收 [S1, S3]。

一段弯曲的中空管只是器官层级的示意符号；形状与大小都作了简化，既不是医学解剖模型，也不是一个放得极大的细胞 [S20]。

summary.en: Places organs within the context of body systems.
summary.zh: 把器官连回身体系统。

detail.en:
Organs work together in systems. The digestive, respiratory and circulatory systems help obtain and transport substances needed by the body’s cells [S1].

This plain silhouette is a context symbol at a separate scale. Open the heart-and-lungs and digestive-system topics for their organ structures and processes; the outline itself does not depict those processes [S20].

器官在系统中共同作用。消化、呼吸和循环系统帮助身体获取并运送细胞所需的物质 [S1]。

这个轮廓只是采用独立比例的背景示意。心肺主题和消化系统主题另有器官结构与过程；身体轮廓本身不表示这些过程 [S20]。
